walk: Four-frame walk cycle in place facing right, little steps, feet stable baseline.
sleep: Four frames falling asleep: gently lower head and body, eyes close. Stay standing or slightly crouched, retain same outfit.
wake: Four frames waking up: lift head and stretch slightly, then return to standing facing right.
jump: Four frames of jumping pose: knees bend slightly then extend legs while raising arms a little, remain centered without moving through the image.
crouch: Four frames crouching down, knees bend and body lowers, head still facing right, final frame holds crouch.
